exposure: apically located congenital left ventricular aneurysm
cohort: A 35-year-old gravida 2, parity 1 pregnant woman and her baby.
finding: This case report details the prenatal diagnosis and postnatal follow-up of a rare apically located left ventricular aneurysm, emphasizing the importance of a multidisciplinary approach despite evolving echocardiographic changes postnatally.
